title: Victory, not number of seats, is the key: Akhilesh amid SP-Congress seat-sharing spat
description: ‘Both the parties will win and form the government in an alliance. When have we talked about defeat? We too are talking about victory...Elections are fought on the basis of ideology. In terms of ideology, the Congress party is number one in the entire country,’ U.P. Congress in-charge Rajendra Pal Gautam says
